paragraphs.text:
Your business here is completed. You see the crowd staring 
covetously at the newly acquired items and you spot Amelia 
looking smug and satisfied with a leather bag full of cash. Mr. 
Warren begins to clear away the tables while Officer Powell 
stands by the door and directs people out of the building and 
into the ever-thickening fog.

Though some seem content to stay and socialize, you feel 
that it would be best to go bed down for the night.
